summary: Los Angeles, California, programmer, Biola University graduate, strong interest in philosophy, particularly Plato and Heraclitus, advocates for classical education, interest in AI and consciousness debates, supports microfinancing initiatives, engages in discussions about Western culture and education, autodidact, enjoys historical fiction, particularly the Master and Commander series, critical of superficial solutions to social problems, emphasizes depth and rigor in learning, involved in creative extracurricular activities.
